title: AI Deployment Manager
description:
Why RapidClaims

US healthcare providers are paid only after every visit is turned into billing codes and submitted as a claim. That work is manual, slow and error-prone, and it is getting harder: claim denial rates have nearly doubled in a decade, from 7% to over 13%, while provider margins have fallen from around 10% to just 1% to 2%. Fixing the revenue cycle is now one of the biggest priorities for every health system in the country, and AI is how they are trying to fix it.

RapidClaims is an AI revenue cycle platform. Our autonomous agents code medical records, improve clinical documentation and manage denials, across 25+ specialties, with 98%+ coding accuracy. Clients include Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), specialty physician groups, community health centers and hospital systems. The company has raised $11 million in total funding from top investors, including Accel and Together Fund.

What sets us apart is speed to value. Where incumbents need tens of thousands of records and months of implementation to cover a new specialty, we need a few hundred records and hours. That advantage only counts if every client goes live quickly, stays stable and keeps growing. This role exists to make sure they do.

Why this role exists

In AI for the revenue cycle, the model is no longer the hard part. The hard part is making it work inside a real provider's workflow: their electronic health record (EHR) system, their specialties, their payer mix, their coders and their habits. The companies winning this market are the ones that get clients live fastest and keep them stable at scale. For a client, the deployment is the product.

Every client goes through the same journey with us: a pilot to prove value, a go-live, a period of stabilisation, then expansion into more of their work. Each stage depends on several teams pulling in the same direction, and we are hiring so that one owner holds that together.

The team you will join is responsible for pilots and live clients. You will work with engineering, data science, operations and quality control every day. You will wear multiple hats: problem solving, design thinking, debugging client issues and getting them resolved, and working with operations to manage client volume and bring efficiency.

What you will own

● The deployment. Run pilots, take clients live, stabilise them and lead their expansion. You are accountable for the client's outcome end to end, and you are the

person who knows where every client stands today.

● The translation. Convert client needs into clear, prioritised asks for our teams, and convert our progress into updates the client can act on. Nothing gets lost between the client and the people building for them.

● The resolution. Trace an issue across data, workflow, model and people, route it to the right owner, and drive it to closure. You report problems solved, not problems found.

● The tooling. Prototype agents, prompts and automations that remove manual steps from this job, deploy them, and measure the impact. Where a process is repeated, you are expected to build rather than repeat.

● The product. Turn patterns you see across clients into product features and process changes, so that every client after yours runs on what you learned.

Your first 45 days

● By day 15. You understand how a chart moves through our platform and through a client's revenue cycle. You have shadowed a live account, sat in on client calls, and mapped where work gets stuck and why.

● By day 30. You are running a pilot: discovery, data and integration scoping, workflow setup with data science, and the first quality review with the coding and quality control teams. You have shipped one small tool that saves someone on the team hours every week.

● By day 45. You own a portfolio of clients. One automation you built is in daily use by the team, and one product or process change exists because you saw a pattern across clients and made the case.

How we will measure success

● Time from pilot start to go-live, and from go-live to a stable, predictable weekly volume.

● Volume moving on time for your clients, and how quickly stuck work gets unstuck.

● Accuracy and quality outcomes for your clients, and how quickly issues reach data science when the model is the cause.

● Expansion: more of each client's specialties, sites and workflows moving onto the platform.

● Manual effort removed from the team by what you built.

What you bring

● 2+ years of experience, with shipped AI work. At least one AI-driven solution you built and put in front of real users: an agent, an automation, an internal tool or a product feature. You are hands-on with prompting, agents and evals, and you can

walk us through what you built, how you tested it, and what broke.

● A fast learner. Healthcare billing and medical coding are deep domains. You do not need to know them today, but you need to pick them up quickly and enjoy doing so. We are betting on learning speed over prior domain exposure.

● A structured thinker. You break messy problems down MECE (mutually exclusive, collectively exhaustive), so nothing is missed and nothing is counted twice, and you can hold that structure while the details keep changing.

● Comfort with data. SQL, Python or advanced spreadsheets, enough to answer your own questions without waiting on someone else.

● Clear communication, written and spoken. You will talk to clients, engineers, coders and founders in the same day, and each of them needs a different version of the same truth.

● Comfort with context switching. This role moves between a client call, a stuck batch and a prompt that is not working. It is not a role with long quiet blocks, and the people who thrive in it find that energising rather than draining.

● High ownership and a problem-solving nature. You start with "how do I fix this", and you want the zero-to-one journey with the mess that comes with it.

Good to have. Exposure to healthcare, billing or US insurance. A prior client-facing or operations role at a startup. Familiarity with agent frameworks, structured outputs and tool calling, or LLM evaluation tools.

What this role is not

● Not an implementation or project-management role where you run a checklist and hand off. You build, debug and own the outcome.

● Not a pure operations role. If building your own tools does not excite you, this will feel like the wrong job.

● Not a quiet role. Several clients, several teams, many open threads at once.

Benefits:

* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* Are you willing to work in Koramangala Bangalore office
* How many years of experience in AI
* How many years of experience in AI deployment
* Have you worked in Health care Industry
* How many No. of end-to-end deployment you have completed
* what is your team leading size
* Do you have managerial experience
* What is your current CTC
* What is your expected CTC
* What is your notice period
* Have you been interviewed by Rapid Claims before?

title: PowerBI Administartor
description:
**This role is for one of our clients**  
  
Industry: IT Services and IT Consulting  
Seniority level: Mid-Senior level

Min Experience: 6+ years  
Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India  
JobType: full-time

We are seeking a Staff Power BI Engineer to join our Analytics and BICOE team. This is a hands-on technical role responsible for the architecture, administration, and strategic enablement of the Power BI and ThoughtSpot platforms across the organization. The ideal candidate will drive platform administration, scalability, governance, report development, and adoption, while partnering closely with engineering, data, and business teams to enable data-driven decision-making at scale. This role owns the end-to-end analytics experience, with a strong emphasis on Power BI platform administration, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), GCP BigQuery (BQ), cloud-native architecture, and high-performance SQL, enabling scalable, governed, and reliable analytics across Albertsons. Please note: This is primarily a Power BI administrator role, with Power BI development and ThoughtSpot administration, development skills considered a strong plus.

**Requirements**
----------------

**Key Responsibilities**

• 5–8 years of experience in data analytics, with expert-level skills in Power BI administration and Power BI Report development. • Own the end-to-end administration, governance, and operations of the Power BI platform, ensuring scalability, security, reliability, and performance. • Administer and manage Power BI tenant settings, licensing models, workspaces, and Premium capacities. • Monitor and troubleshoot Power BI Premium capacity utilization and performance using the Premium Capacity Metrics app and related tools. • Design, install, configure, and manage Power BI Gateways and enterprise data connections. • Troubleshoot and resolve Power BI ecosystem issues, including report access failures, dataset and dataflow refresh issues, gateway connectivity problems, and service disruptions. • Develop Power BI reports and semantic models based on business requirements. • Debug and optimize Power BI report and semantic model performance using Tabular Editor, DAX Studio, and other third-party tools; provide recommendations to report developers. • Automate platform administration, monitoring, and governance using PowerShell or Python and Power BI REST APIs. • Configure and manage Power BI Copilot tenant settings, feature flags, and capacity prerequisites; establish enterprise guardrails and best practices for Copilot usage including dataset readiness, semantic model quality, and user enablement. • Monitor Power BI Copilot adoption, usage patterns, and platform impact, and provide actionable insights and recommendations to stakeholders. • Enforce security and governance standards, including workspace controls and role-based access at scale. • Partner with engineering, data, and business teams to drive Power BI adoption and best practices. • Administer and manage ThoughtSpot SaaS environments, including tenant configurations and feature enablement. • Monitor ThoughtSpot platform health, usage analytics, and overall system performance. • Configure and manage ThoughtSpot users, groups, and role-based access control (RBAC). • Use ThoughtSpot Modeling Language (TML) to support content migration and promotion across non-production and production environments. • Coordinate with ThoughtSpot vendors and Albertsons change management teams to plan and execute platform upgrades. • Troubleshoot ThoughtSpot platform issues and work with ThoughtSpot support as needed.

  

**Required Qualifications**

• 5–8 years of experience administering and supporting the Power BI ecosystem in an enterprise environment. • Experience with Microsoft Fabric, including a solid understanding of Fabric concepts and capabilities, is a strong plus. • Hands-on experience automating platform administration, monitoring, and governance using REST APIs and PowerShell or Python scripts is a strong plus. • Expert-level, hands-on experience with Power BI report development, paginated reports, and semantic (tabular) model development. • Deep expertise in Power BI platform architecture, including licensing models, Premium capacities, gateways, and tenant administration. • Advanced hands-on experience with PowerShell for automation and operational management. • Proven expertise in diagnosing and resolving complex Power BI performance and reliability issues. • Strong experience managing enterprise BI security models and access controls. • 5–8 years of experience in data analytics with expert-level skills in ThoughtSpot development. • Deep expertise in ThoughtSpot architecture and administration, including tenant configuration, feature rollout, and data modeling. • Hands-on experience with TML for environment migrations and content promotion. • Strong experience managing ThoughtSpot security, including users, groups, RBAC, and platform enablement, with the ability to define and enforce governance guardrails for ThoughtSpot Spotter 3. • Ability to support operational needs during US Pacific Time (PST) business hours.

  

Must-have skills

Power BI administration, BigQuery, SQL

Good-to-have skills

ThoughtSpot, Google Cloud Platform, Governance

title: Linux System and Hardware Administrator
description:
**General Information**

**Job Title:** Linux System and Hardware Administrator

**Primary Job Location:** Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

**Location Flexibility:** Hybrid, Bengaluru based (minimum 3 days a week in office)

**Employment Type:** Permanent, Full-Time

**Hiring Timeline (Hiring month):** Immediate

**Reporting Line:** Head of Corporate Technology

**Application Deadline:** Open until filled

**Notice Period:** 30 days or less preferred, 60 days maximum

**Existing Vacancy:** Yes

**Application Deadline:** Open until Filled

**Shift Timings:** 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST

**About Fulfillment IQ (FIQ):**

Fulfillment IQ is a supply chain engineering and transformation company that helps brands, retailers, and 3PLs design, build, and scale high-performance logistics operations.

We work at the intersection of strategy, operations, and technology where we solve complex, real-world problems across warehouse design, automation, order management, transportation, and end-to-end supply chain execution.

Our teams combine deep domain expertise with strong technical capability, delivering outcomes through consulting, systems implementation, and proprietary platforms that accelerate time-to-value and reduce delivery risk.

**Role Overview:**

The Linux System and Hardware Administrator is the hands-on owner of day-to-day operations for Fulfillment IQ’s Linux servers and for the laptops and hardware used by our India-based team. The role sits in the Corporate Technology team within FIQ Group Shared Services, which supports both our services and product businesses. You will run routine server administration, set up and recover devices across Linux, Windows, and macOS, and resolve support tickets, working from the runbooks, policies, and security controls set by the Head of Corporate Technology and alongside colleagues based mainly in Canada.

**Mandate:**

* Keep laptops and hardware for India-based staff set up, tracked, and working
* Handle routine Linux server administration using defined runbooks
* Resolve support tickets quickly and escalate what you cannot fix with clear notes
* Keep documentation, asset records, and ticket history accurate

**Must-Have Qualifications:**

* 3 to 5 years of system administration experience, including hands-on hardware and end-user support
* Strong Linux administration from the command line (Ubuntu or RHEL family): users and permissions, file systems, services, packages, and logs. Linux is non-negotiable for this role
* Experience setting up and troubleshooting web servers (Apache or Nginx) on Linux, with Bash scripting for routine tasks
* Comfort working across Windows 11 and macOS alongside Linux. Strong Linux plus one of the other two is acceptable
* Experience administering a directory and identity platform, such as Microsoft 365 and Entra ID or an on-premise Windows Active Directory domain
* Hardware troubleshooting and component replacement, plus networking fundamentals: IP addressing, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, and VPN

**Nice to Have:**

* Active Microsoft Azure Administrator (AZ-104) certification. Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305) is a strong advantage
* An active Linux certification, such as CompTIA Linux+, RHCSA, or LFCS
* Microsoft Intune administration (device enrolment, compliance policies, app deployment)
* Exposure to DevOps tooling such as Docker, cloud virtual machines (Azure or AWS), or CI/CD runners
* PowerShell or Python scripting
* Any certification listed on your resume must be active.
* Successful candidates who do not yet hold AZ-104 and AZ-305 will be expected to complete both after joining.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Hardware & Device Support**

* Set up, image, and configure Windows 11 laptops and Mac devices for new joiners, and enrol them in device management
* Collect, wipe, and reissue devices from leavers within agreed timelines
* Troubleshoot hardware issues and coordinate repairs and warranty claims with OEMs and local vendors
* Maintain the asset register for every device, linked to the employee it is assigned to
* Support Bengaluru office equipment, including network devices, Wi-Fi, printers, and meeting room technology

**Linux System Administration**

* Perform routine Linux server administration: user accounts, permissions, service restarts, disk space, and log checks
* Apply OS updates and patches following the schedule and runbooks set by Corporate Technology
* Monitor server health alerts and escalate issues to senior team members with clear notes
* Run scheduled backup checks and report any failures

**User Support**

* Respond to and resolve support tickets for hardware, software, accounts, and access
* Support Microsoft 365 account setup, password resets, and MFA enrolment
* Escalate issues you cannot resolve to the right owner in Corporate Technology or DevOps, with the steps already taken
* Give staff practical guidance on using their devices safely

**Security & Compliance**

* Confirm endpoint protection, disk encryption, and required updates are active on every device
* Follow the access, device, and data handling policies set by Corporate Technology
* Report suspected security incidents immediately
* Support license and subscription tracking by assigning and reclaiming seats for joiners and leavers

**Documentation & Improvement**

* Keep tickets, asset records, and runbooks current
* Document recurring issues and their fixes so the team can resolve them faster next time
* Write simple scripts to automate repetitive tasks, reviewed by senior team members

**What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days:**

**30 Days In**

* Learn FIQ’s systems, tools, ticketing process, and runbooks
* Set up devices for new joiners independently
* Reconcile the India asset register against active headcount
* Build working relationships with the Corporate Technology and DevOps teams

**60 Days In**

* Resolve support tickets within agreed response and resolution times
* Handle routine Linux administration and patching independently using runbooks
* Own joiner and leaver device workflows from start to finish

**90 Days In**

* Be the go-to contact for hardware and device support in India
* Add runbook entries for the most common recurring issues
* Deliver at least one script that removes a manual step from a routine task

**Key Performance Indicators:**

* Ticket response and resolution times
* New joiner devices ready on Day 1, and leaver devices recovered on time
* Asset register accuracy
* Patch compliance on assigned servers and devices
* Internal customer satisfaction

**Interview Process:**

* Screening call with our Talent Acquisition team
* A 90-minute in-person technical assessment at our Bengaluru office with the Head of Corporate Technology. The first part is scenario-based Q&A. The second part is hands-on at a computer: you will work in a Linux environment, set up a web server, and troubleshoot basic operations on that server, and you will be questioned on networking and typical hardware issues

**Why You’ll Love Working Here:**

At Fulfillment IQ, we don’t just build supply chain solutions; we build long-term careers.  
We believe in giving our people real ownership, real influence, and meaningful responsibility. Whether you’re leading a client relationship, shaping a solution, or building internal capability, your decisions have a visible impact.

We operate with a high-trust, high-standards culture that values clear thinking, collaboration, and accountability without unnecessary hierarchy or bureaucracy.

Here’s what makes Fulfillment IQ a rewarding place to work:

**Work That Matters**  
You’ll help solve real operational challenges that directly impact global commerce, customer experience, and supply chain performance.

**Career Growth That Matters**  
We invest in mentorship, leadership development, and continuous learning — supporting both vertical growth and long-term career progression.

**Flexibility to Thrive**  
We support remote and hybrid work models, flexible schedules, and trust our teams to manage their time responsibly.

**We Celebrate Impact**  
From project wins to personal milestones, we recognize contribution, celebrate progress, and value consistency over heroics.

**A Collaborative Culture**  
You’ll work alongside experienced consultants, engineers, product leaders, and commercial professionals who value ownership, transparency, and high standards.

**Perks you’ll appreciate:**

**Health and Wellness**

* Comprehensive group medical insurance for you and your family, in line with local practice
* Employee wellness programs where applicable

**Time Off**

* Competitive paid time off, sick leave, and public holidays
* Flexible leave policies that respect local labour standards

**Retirement and Financial Security**

* Statutory retirement and social security contributions (Employees' Provident Fund, Employees' State Insurance where applicable, and gratuity)
* Employee stock options (ESOP), where applicable

**Professional Growth**

* Dedicated learning and development budget, with support for skills, leadership, and career progression

**Flexible Work**

* Remote and hybrid work options, flexible hours aligned to role and client needs

**Additional Perks**

* Equipment and workstation allowances, internet and business travel reimbursements, team events and offsites

**Work Authorization:**

* Applicants must be legally authorized to work in India.

**Use of Artificial Intelligence in Hiring:**

FIQ uses artificial intelligence to assist in the screening, assessment, and shortlisting of applications for this position, including features within our applicant tracking system. AI supports human reviewers and does not make hiring decisions on its own. Final hiring decisions are made by FIQ personnel. If you have questions about how AI is used in this process, contact hr@fulfillmentiq.com.

**Accommodations:**

FIQ is committed to an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. Consistent with the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, accommodations are available on request at any stage of recruitment and assessment. Contact hr@fulfillmentiq.com, and we will work with you to meet your needs.

**Candidate Privacy:**

Your personal information is collected and used for recruitment purposes in accordance with FIQ's Candidate Privacy Notice, available at here, and in accordance with India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. This includes the use of AI-assisted screening described above and cross-border storage or processing that may occur in the United States. By applying, you acknowledge this notice. Questions: hr@fulfillmentiq.com.

**Equal Opportunity:**

Fulfillment IQ is a people-first company built on trust, collaboration, and ownership. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and high-performing workplace. We provide equal opportunity in line with the Constitution of India and consider all qualified applicants without regard to religion, race, caste, sex, place of birth, disability, or any other characteristic protected under applicable Indian law.

**Safe and Respectful Workplace:**

FIQ maintains a safe and respectful workplace and complies with the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 (POSH). We have a constituted Internal Committee to receive and address complaints, and every employee is covered by our anti-harassment policy from day one.

**Learn More About Us:**

**LinkedIn:** **Fulfillment IQ**

**YouTube:** **eCom Logistics Podcast YouTube**

**Job Description: ServiceNow Solution Architect / Engineering Manager (AI-Focused)**
=====================================================================================

**Grade / Level:** Manager
  
**Experience:** 8–14 years
  
**Team:** EY GDS – TTT ServiceNow & CT Teams
  
**Location:** Bengaluru / India GDS

**Role Summary**
----------------

The ServiceNow Solution Architect – Manager is a senior consulting and technology leadership role within EY GDS. This role leads the architecture, design, and delivery of AI-enabled, enterprise-scale ServiceNow solutions for global clients. The position combines deep ServiceNow platform expertise, Now Assist and GenAI Controller–led architecture, consulting leadership, and people management. The individual acts as a trusted advisor to client and internal stakeholders, driving platform transformation aligned to EY consulting methodologies, risk frameworks, and business outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Solution Architecture & Technical Leadership**

* Architect end-to-end ServiceNow solutions across ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, HRSD, CSM, SecOps, and custom applications
* Define secure, scalable, and resilient ServiceNow architectures aligned with EY GDS and client enterprise standards
* Lead complex integrations using REST, SOAP, MID Server, and third-party enterprise platforms
* Establish best practices for data models, workflows, automation, and performance analytics
* Review and govern technical designs, AI feature usage, and code quality across engagements

### **ServiceNow AI, NowAssist & GenAI Architecture Leadership**

* Define and lead NowAssist and GenAI Controller–based solution architectures aligned to ServiceNow best practices
* Design AI-augmented use cases including Agent Assist, Virtual Agent, AI Search, case summarization, and resolution intelligence
* Architect context-aware GenAI workflows while ensuring data privacy, security, and responsible AI controls
* Partner with CT/CTP and TTT stakeholders to align AI adoption with platform roadmaps and value realization goals
* Evaluate ServiceNow AI features across releases and drive enterprise-scale adoption strategies

### **Program & Delivery Leadership**

* Lead large-scale ServiceNow and AI-enabled transformation programs across multiple workstreams
* Collaborate with engagement and program leaders to manage scope, risks, quality, and timelines
* Proactively manage architecture risks, platform constraints, and delivery escalations
* Ensure compliance with EY GDS delivery governance, security, and quality standards

### **Consulting Manager Responsibilities**

* Serve as a trusted advisor to client executives and senior IT leaders
* Translate business problems into ServiceNow and AI-led solution roadmaps
* Lead executive workshops, architecture reviews, and value-based discussions
* Support pre-sales, estimations, solutioning, and RFP responses
* Drive measurable outcomes through adoption, change, and value realization strategies

### **People & Practice Leadership**

* Manage, coach, and develop ServiceNow architects and engineers aligned to EY career frameworks
* Conduct performance reviews, goal setting, and capability development
* Build AI and ServiceNow competencies through certifications, training, and innovation initiatives
* Support hiring, onboarding, and capacity planning for GDS TTT and CT teams

### **Governance, Risk & Innovation**

* Define platform governance, AI usage standards, and reusable architectural assets
* Ensure responsible AI usage aligned with EY risk, compliance, and data governance principles
* Promote innovation leveraging AI, automation, and emerging ServiceNow capabilities

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
------------------------------------

* 8–14 years of overall IT experience with 6+ years of hands-on ServiceNow platform experience
* Strong expertise in ServiceNow architecture, data model, scripting (JavaScript, Glide API)
* Deep understanding of ServiceNow AI architecture including Now Assist, GenAI Controller, AI Search, and Predictive Intelligence
* Hands-on experience enabling GenAI-driven workflows, Agent Assist, and Virtual Agent capabilities
* Experience leading enterprise-scale ServiceNow or AI-enabled transformations
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator and CIS certifications (mandatory)
* ServiceNow Certified Architect or advanced AI-focused certifications (preferred)
* Strong consulting, stakeholder management, and leadership skills

**Preferred Experience**
------------------------

* Experience working in EY GDS, Big 4, or large global consulting organizations
* Exposure to AI governance, risk, compliance, and data privacy controls in enterprise environments
* Multi-industry experience including Technology, BFSI, Healthcare, or Manufacturing
* Strong executive communication and storytelling skills

**Key Success Factors**
-----------------------

* Balances architectural depth with consulting and leadership mindset
* Drives responsible and scalable adoption of ServiceNow AI capabilities
* Demonstrates strong client orientation and outcome-driven delivery focus
* Builds high-performing teams and contributes to GDS practice growth

  
  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Team Lead | Unix | Bengaluru | Engineering | Hybrid Cloud Engineering
description:
**Team Lead | Unix | Bengaluru | Engineering | Hybrid Cloud Engineering**
  
• **Job requisition ID** : 113546
  
• **Location**: Bengaluru
  
• **Entity**: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP

**Team Lead | Engineering, AI & Data – Engineering | Unix**

  

**Location:** Bangalore

  

**The team**

Engineering helps empower and drive mission-critical solutions whether we need to modernize existing systems or implement new technology products and platforms. Through innovation, we improve financial performance, accelerate new digital businesses and fuel growth. Learn more about Engineering, AI and Data

  

**Your work profile**

  

We are seeking an experienced Unix Administrator – Senior Consultant to support, manage, and optimize enterprise Linux/Unix environments across on-premises data centers and hybrid infrastructures. This role requires strong hands-on expertise with Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Ubuntu Server, Linux clustering technologies, and advanced troubleshooting skills. The Senior Consultant will provide L2/L3 technical support, drive operational excellence, ensure platform stability, and contribute to automation and modernization initiatives within the Unix/Linux tower. Key Responsibilities UNIX, Red Hat HA, SUSE HA, Red Hat Clustering, Veritas Clustering, Apache Unix/Linux Server Administration

* Perform installation, configuration, administration, and troubleshooting of Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) and Ubuntu Server environments.

* Conduct OS patching, kernel updates, security hardening, performance tuning, and lifecycle management.

* Manage logical volumes (LVM), file systems, RAID configurations, and storage integrations. Clustering & High Availability

* Implement, configure, and support Linux clustering technologies, such as: o Red Hat Cluster Suite (Pacemaker/Corosync) o HAProxy / Keepalived o DRBD, fencing agents, failover resources

* Perform cluster validation, failover testing, quorum configuration, and cluster performance diagnostics.

* Troubleshoot cluster failures, split-brain issues, node communication problems, and HA resource constraints. Scripting, Automation & Tools

* Develop and maintain automation scripts using Shell/Bash, Python, and Ansible.

* Automate routine tasks such as patching, configuration deployment, monitoring, and health audits.

* Work with configuration management and orchestration tools (Ansible, Puppet, SaltStack preferred). Networking & Security

* Manage Linux network configurations including bonding, VLANs, routing, DNS configurations, and firewall rules (firewalld/iptables).

* Implement OS-level security best practices, SELinux policies (enforcing/permissive), and vulnerability remediation.

* Support authentication integrations with LDAP/AD/Samba/Kerberos. Monitoring, Troubleshooting & Operations

* Monitor system health, performance, logs, and hardware components using tools like Nagios, Zabbix, Prometheus, or Red Hat Insights.

* Handle L2/L3 escalations for OS performance issues, application failures, kernel panics, filesystem corruption, and networking defects.

* Provide root-cause analysis (RCA), incident resolution, and support planned maintenance activities. Documentation & Collaboration

* Maintain accurate SOPs, topology documentation, server inventories, and configuration guides.

* Collaborate with middleware, database, storage, network, and security teams for cross functional troubleshooting.

* Participate in DR drills, compliance audits, and capacity planning exercises. Required Skills

* Strong hands-on experience with Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) and Ubuntu Server in enterprise environments.

* Expertise in Linux clustering technologies (Pacemaker/Corosync, HAProxy, Keepalived, etc.).

* Proficiency with Shell/Bash scripting, and familiarity with Ansible automation.

• Strong understanding of Linux internals: processes, memory, storage, networking, and kernel-level troubleshooting. • Experience with LVM, filesystems (ext4, XFS), permissions, SELinux, systemd, and performance analysis tools.

* Ability to troubleshoot hardware, OS, networking, and storage-related issues in a multi-tier environment.

  

**Key skills required:**

* Education : Any Bachelor’s or Master’s degree

* 3+ years of experience in Unix/Linux system administration.

* Hands-on experience with clustering and HA implementations in production.

* Exposure to virtualization platforms (VMware/Hyper-V/KVM) and cloud basics is an advantage.

* Familiarity with ITIL practices (Incident, Change, Problem). Good to have

* Certifications such as RHCSA, RHCE, Linux Foundation Certified Engineer (LFCE), or equivalent.

* Experience with containerization (Docker/Podman) and orchestration (Kubernetes) is a plus.

* Experience in managed services or large enterprise IT operations.

**It’s more than a career at NAB. It’s about more meaningful work, more global opportunities and more innovation beyond boundaries .**

Your job is just one part of your life. When you bring your ideas, energy, and hunger for growth, you’ll be recognised and rewarded for your contribution in return. You’ll have our support to excel for our customers, deliver positive change for our communities and grow your career.

Step into a role where you move from contributing to owning. As a Platform Engineer (SDE2) at NAB, you will be a trusted, independent member of the team responsible for the end-to-end delivery of features and services that empower thousands of developers across the bank. You will take ownership of key components within our multi-cloud Internal Developer Platform, designing, building, and maintaining the tools that enable our engineering teams to ship software faster and more securely. This is an opportunity to deepen your expertise in cloud-native technologies, drive meaningful improvements to the developer experience, and play a vital role in our mission to become Australia's best engineering bank.

What You'll Do

As a SDE2, you will be a hands-on builder, taking ideas from concept to production and ensuring their ongoing reliability and performance.

* **Design and Build Platform Services:** Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable and reliable components of our developer platform, focusing on areas such as secure CI/CD, observability, on-demand environments, or cloud infrastructure management.
* **Manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC):** Build and manage our multi-cloud infrastructure, using IaC principles and tools. You will create reusable modules and automated workflows for provisioning and managing resources.
* **Enhance CI/CD Pipelines:** Develop and enhance secure, high-velocity CI/CD pipelines using tools like Harness, ensuring robust automation for the build, testing, and deployment of a wide variety of applications.
* **Implement Observability:** Implement and manage comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) to provide deep visibility into the health and performance of our platform services and hosted applications.
* **Improve Developer Experience:** Collaborate closely with product engineering teams to understand their pain points, gather requirements, and build self-service tools and workflows that make their lives easier.
* **Uphold Engineering Excellence:** Participate actively in code reviews, providing constructive feedback to your peers. You will also contribute to technical design discussions and help maintain high standards for code quality and system reliability.
* **Implementing Ephemeral Infrastructure:** Build and implement on-demand, ephemeral environments that can come up automatedly, from our internal developer portals spawning up all the dependencies with components of test automation running as part of the on-demand infrastructure spin up.
* **Nack for Risk and Security:** As part of being a banking / financial institution, security and risk in ingrained in our daily activity. A key competency would be not just building great tech but also building with the best practices of security & risk ingrained in our daily work.

What You'll Bring

We are looking for experienced engineers with a passion for automation, reliability, and building tools that developers love to use.

* **Experience:** 4-7 years of professional experience in a Platform Engineering, DevOps, or a backend engineering role.
* **Cloud Proficiency:** Hands-on experience building and managing infrastructure in at least one major cloud provider (AWS or Google Cloud), with exposure to core services like EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, or their equivalents.
* **Container and Orchestration Expertise:** Strong, practical experience with containerization using Docker and container orchestration using Kubernetes. You should be comfortable writing Kubernetes manifests and managing workloads.
* **Infrastructure as Code (IaC):** Proven proficiency with IaC tools such as Terraform and Ansible for automating infrastructure provisioning and configuration management.
* **CI/CD Implementation:** Demonstrable experience designing, building, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools like Harness, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar.
* **Programming and Scripting:** Strong programming and scripting skills in languages such as Python, Go, Java, or Shell, with a focus on writing clean, maintainable, and efficient code.

Good to Have

These skills are not mandatory but will set you apart and enable you to make a faster impact:

* Experience with advanced CI/CD and deployment orchestration tools like Harness.
* Knowledge of service mesh technologies (e.g., Istio, Linkerd) for managing microservices communication.
* Familiarity with building developer tools or portals using TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks.
* Experience working in a regulated financial services environment and an understanding of associated security and compliance requirements.
* Cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate).

**A diverse and inclusive workplace works better for everyone:**

Our goal is to foster a culture that fills us with pride, rooted in trust and respect. NAB is committed to creating a positive and supportive environment where everyone is encouraged to embrace their true, authentic selves. A diverse and inclusive workplace where our differences are celebrated, and our contributions are valued. It’s a huge part of what makes NAB such a special place to be.

**More focus on you:**

We’re committed to delivering a positive experience for our colleagues and a workplace you can be proud of. We support our colleagues to balance their careers and personal life through flexible working arrangements such as hybrid working and job sharing and competitive financial and lifestyle benefits. We invest in our colleagues through world class development programs (Distinctive Leadership and Career Qualified in Banking), and empower you to learn, grow and pursue exciting career opportunities

title: Parts Inventory Analyst
description:
**Career Area:**

Supply Chain and Logistics

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

**Job Summary**

Processes job requisitions and provides support for supply chain, sourcing, cost, price analyses and contract/purchase order generation.

The Supply Chain Services (SCS) group part of Product Support & Logistics Division currently has a job opening for a “Parts Inventory Analyst” position located in Bangalore, India facility.

**Enterprise Logistics Solutions (ELS):**

The Enterprise Logistics Solutions (ELS) being part of SCS group is responsible for seamless execution of critical processes for Caterpillar manufacturing facilities in the areas of New Product Introduction (NPI), Material Requirement Planning (MRP), Electronic Data Interface (EDI), Shipping label and Analytics solutions. Supply Chain Services ELS team delivers value by initiating and participating in business-critical projects and solutions.

This role supports RIOP HMS Product Group by leading Supply Chain Guru (Network Inventory Model) activities, inventory optimization, supply chain analytics, and digital solutions aligned with Caterpillar’s OPACC strategy. Key responsibilities include developing network inventory recommendations, improving material availability, optimizing inventory investments, and delivering business insights through Power BI and Power Apps solutions. Through data-driven decision-making, automation, and cross-functional collaboration, the role enhances operational efficiency, inventory health, product readiness, and customer value.

**What You Will Do:**

* Lead Supply Chain Guru (Network Inventory Model) activities to develop inventory recommendations and optimize inventory investments across the RIOP HMS Product Group.
* Analyze demand, supply, and inventory trends to improve material availability and support business planning decisions.
* Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and Power Apps solutions to enhance operational visibility and decision-making.
* Drive inventory optimization initiatives, including surplus reduction, inventory health monitoring, and exception management.
* Provide analytical support for S&OP, dealer inventory planning, and product readiness reviews.
* Deliver business intelligence, performance reporting, and actionable insights to supply chain and product group stakeholders.
* Identify and implement automation opportunities to improve process efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support OPACC objectives, operational excellence, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Degree Requirement**

* Bachelor’s degree in commerce/science/engineering or equivalent degree
* Minimum 8-9 years of experience in Supply chain management, Logistics, 3PL, Warehousing, Service parts Logistics.

**What You Have**

Business Acumen: Knowledge of business concepts, tools, and processes that are needed for making sound decisions in the context of the company's business; ability to apply this knowledge appropriately to diverse situations.

Level Working Knowledge:

* Comments on the organization's business model and financial goals.
* Communicates key considerations for business decision making process.
* Cites examples of types of information needed to make sound business decisions.
* Participates in business tasks to get things done in own unit or area.
* Caters to key stakeholders and their priorities.
* Apply Supply Chain Guru to generate network inventory recommendations and optimize inventory investments.
* Analyze demand, supply, and inventory data to improve material availability and business performance.
* Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards to enable data-driven decision-making.
* Build Power Apps and automation solutions to streamline processes and improve efficiency.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to drive inventory optimization and operational excellence.
* Preferably to have working experience with multiple ERP systems like SAP, Mainframe, etc.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to solve complex problems
* Ability to prioritize and multi-task various responsibilities
* Independently work on issue resolution and enhancements to existing solutions
* Strong customer focus and ability to collaborate with cross functional teams

Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.

Level Working Knowledge:

* Approaches a situation or problem by defining the problem or issue and determining its significance.
* Makes a systematic comparison of two or more alternative solutions.
* Uses flow charts, Pareto charts, fish diagrams, etc. to disclose meaningful data patterns.
* Identifies the major forces, events, and people impacting and impacted by the situation at hand.
* Uses logic and intuition to make inferences about the meaning of the data and arrive at conclusions.

Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.

Level Basic Understanding:

* Explains characteristics and steps in an effective decision-making process.
* Identifies issues and communicates with others when a decision needs to be made.
* Names decision makers in own environment and cites examples of past decisions.
* Describes types of decisions incumbent may and may not make in own job or function.

Logistics Management: Knowledge of logistics and management; ability to follow proper processes and run operations for effective and efficient movement of materials and finished products.

Level Basic Understanding:

* Explains how improvements in logistics contribute to competitive advantage in the marketplace.
* Identifies issues and considerations for inbound and outbound logistics.
* Documents internal and external informative sources or proprietary materials about logistics management.
* Describes basic logistical processes and sub-processes.

Manufacturing Requirements Planning (MRP): Knowledge of the processes, practices and systems used in manufacturing requirements planning (MRP); ability to optimize planning for manufacturing cycles and ensure capacity and materials availability.

Level Basic Understanding:

* Describes basic concepts of materials and capacity management processes and procedures.
* Describes product life cycle and associated MRP cycle.
* Identifies parameters and considerations used in making decisions about production runs.
* Describes the use of bills of materials and other documentation needed to provide supplies.

Process Improvement: Understanding and insight into evaluating current product quality and production methods and ability to maintains focus on the continuous improvement of processes, products and services.

Level Working Knowledge:

* Defines the critical workflow for executing key processes.
* Identifies process problems that limit performance.
* Implements methods for improving and establishing controls for critical processes.
* Focuses on the most significant problems to maximize efficiency gains.
* Surfaces systemic problems to be addressed at the organizational level.

Project Management: Knowledge of effective project management strategies and tactics; ability to plan, organize, monitor, and control projects, ensuring efficient utilization of technical and administrative resources to achieve project objectives.

Level Basic Understanding:

* Identifies project management tools and requirements within own function.
* Describes the key objectives, phases and deliverables of a current project.
* Explains the concepts of phase, activity, task, and deliverable.
* Gives examples of critical paths in projects.

Supplier Management - MFG: Knowledge of processes and methods to effectively manage business relationships and transactions with suppliers of raw materials or product components; ability to apply related knowledge, experience and skills into real practice.

Level Basic Understanding:

* Describes the typical tasks associated with using and managing suppliers.
* Defines common terms and conditions of agreements with suppliers.
* Explains the organizational process for soliciting and selecting suppliers.
* States the roles and responsibilities of one's own and suppliers' staff.

Supply Chain Management - MFG: Knowledge of functions, principles and techniques used in supply chain management; ability to develop and use, strategies, practices and tools for controlling the logistical processes.

Level Basic Understanding:

* Locates and interprets walk-throughs of the consumption stream and associated provision stream.
* Identifies goals and objectives of effective supply chain management.
* Describes major areas associated with supply chain management.
* Cites multiple examples of waste, high costs and inefficiencies associated with supply chains.

**What You Will Get:**

Our goal at Caterpillar is for you to have a rewarding career. Our teams are critical to the success of our customers who build a better world. Here you earn more than just wage, because we value your performance, we offer a total rewards package that provides day one benefits along with the potential of a variable bonus. Additional benefits include paid annual leave, flexi leave, medical and insurance (prorated based upon hire date).

Enterprise Technology Operations – Cyber, Resiliency and Recovery Specialist

II. Your Impact
  
The Engineering Cyber, Disaster Recovery, Resiliency and Recovery Specialist manages resiliency, disaster recovery, and cyber recovery testing for critical applications across Engineering and Business Units. The role supports the development of policies, governance, standards, and testing frameworks that help ensure business resilience, service continuity, and recoverability are appropriately validated.
  
This role partners closely with Technology Infrastructure, Application Teams, Risk Management, Corporate Services, Operational Risk, Internal Audit, and Business teams to plan, coordinate, and execute technology resiliency events, including Disaster Recovery testing, Cyber Recovery testing, Data Center failover tests, building power-down events, concentration testing, pandemic tests, and industry/regulatory resiliency exercises.
  
The specialist helps application and infrastructure teams validate recovery strategies, understand recovery dependencies, establish order of recovery, maintain evidence, identify control gaps, and improve resiliency processes.
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
III. Our Impact
  
Division Description
  
The Technology Division
  
Our team of engineers builds solutions to the most complex problems. We develop cutting-edge systems and processes that form the core of the business and enable transactions to move in milliseconds. We provide real-time access to critical deal information and crunch billions of data points each day to inform firm-wide market insights and strategies.
  
Team members have the opportunity to work at the forefront of technology innovation alongside industry leaders and make significant contributions to the field.
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
Team Description
  
Enterprise Technology Operations – Engineering Cyber, Resiliency and Recovery Specialist
  
Enterprise Technology Operations (Engineering Cyber, Resiliency and Recovery Specialist) is responsible for strategic initiatives that reduce risk and improve resiliency and recoverability across Engineering.
  
The team ensures effective recovery plans are in place, aligned with firm resiliency strategies, and validated across people, products, platforms, and functions.
  
The team drives adoption of standards, controls, platforms, and automation to improve recovery plan quality, reduce manual effort, support Business Continuity test credit, track exemptions, maintain evidence, and identify key application and infrastructure dependencies.
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
IV. How You Will Fulfill Your Potential
  

* Manage education, awareness, and adoption of Engineering Resiliency, Disaster Recovery, and Cyber Recovery programs across Engineering divisions and Business Units.
* Engage business units and application teams to review, improve, and validate resiliency and recovery plans.
* Partner with technology business leaders to ensure critical applications are recoverable, recovery dependencies are understood, and recovery capabilities are tested regularly.
* Lead and coordinate infrastructure and application Disaster Recovery testing, Cyber Recovery testing, Data Center failover events, and building power-down events.
* Define test scope including shared service dependencies, upstream and downstream application dependencies, infrastructure dependencies, order of recovery, and critical recovery milestones.
* Work with application owners to adopt mandated controls and improve recovery procedures in line with resiliency and recovery requirements.
* Support Cyber Recovery testing by helping teams validate their ability to recover during cyberattack scenarios and execute recovery procedures.
* Coordinate and manage regulatory resiliency recovery tests, including:

o SIFMA industry-wide exercises
  
o SPOOR-related tests
  
o MAS-guided resiliency events
  

* Maintain test documentation and evidence in accordance with governance, internal audit, risk, and regulatory expectations.

* Partner with Operational Risk Management, Internal Audit, Risk Management, and Technology stakeholders to ensure resiliency activities align with firm strategy and application requirements.
* Conduct and coordinate Business Impact Analysis (BIA) reviews to understand workflows, recovery needs, dependencies, workarounds, and recovery alternatives during outage or cyber recovery scenarios.
* Act as a trusted advisor to business divisions and application teams on:

o Business resiliency
  
o Cyber recovery readiness
  
o Recovery simulations
  
o Testing approaches
  
o Risk mitigation strategies
  

* Support governance forums, resiliency committees, risk committees, threat awareness activities, assurance reviews, and planning discussions.
* Drive process improvements by identifying gaps in procedures, testing execution, control adoption, recovery documentation, and evidence management.
* Identify opportunities for automation and tooling to improve recovery planning and reduce manual effort.

title: Salesforce Engineer
description:
Welcome to Natus Sensory India
  
We are continuing to grow our business in India and are now looking to expand our team there. Be part of this exciting journey right from the start!
  
  
Natus Sensory India are a leading manufacturer of medical devices and software for a range of solutions, including eight sensory nervous systems. Our mission is to improve patient outcomes in target markets through innovative screening, diagnostic and treatment solutions. We manufacture and distribute a range of medical device products used in the diagnosis of human disorders of sensory system and neural pathways.
  
  
**SUMMARY:**  
Natus Sensory is seeking a Salesforce Engineer to own the end-to-end architecture, design, and technical governance of our Salesforce platform. This role is responsible for translating business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable Salesforce solutions across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and CPQ, along with integration touchpoints across our broader enterprise systems, including our ERP platform.
  
**This is not a design-only role:** he is also expected to personally implement enhancements and serve as the top-tier escalation point when issues arise, rolling up their sleeves to resolve urgent production, integration, and CPQ problems directly. The ideal candidate has deep, hands-on architecture experience across the full Salesforce platform lifecycle -- from data model and security design through integration architecture, hands-on build, and release governance -- and can operate independently as the primary technical authority for Salesforce within the organization. This person will partner closely with the business-side Salesforce admin team, the broader IT organization, and the Natus Neuro IT team (TSA partner) on shared systems.
  
  
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
  
Salesforce Platform Architecture & Strategy (25%)
  

* Own the overall Salesforce architecture strategy, including org structure, data model, sharing/security model, and platform scalability roadmap
* Translate business requirements from Sales, Service, and Operations stakeholders into scalable, well-governed technical designs
* Define and enforce architectural standards, design patterns, and best practices across Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and declarative automation (Flow)
* Evaluate new Salesforce releases, features, and AppExchange products; recommend adoption where it advances the roadmap
* Lead architectural review of major enhancements, custom development, and third-party package implementations
* Maintain a multi-year Salesforce technical roadmap aligned with business strategy

Integration Architecture (20%)
  

* Design and govern integration architecture between Salesforce and enterprise systems, including ERP (Oracle EBS or similar), Microsoft 365, and other business systems
* Architect and oversee middleware/integration platform usage (MuleSoft or comparable iPaaS) for real-time and batch integrations
* Define API strategy, data synchronization patterns, and error-handling/monitoring standards across integrations
* Partner with ERP, data, and infrastructure teams to ensure integration reliability and data integrity across systems
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex, cross-system integration issues

Enhancement Implementation & Hands-On Development (15%)
  

* Personally build and deploy approved enhancements -- including Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flow automation, and configuration -- rather than handing designs off exclusively to others
* Own delivery of enhancement projects end-to-end: requirements, build, testing, and release, balancing scope, quality, and timeline
* Partner with the business-side Salesforce admin team to convert approved designs into working, tested solutions in the org
* Write and maintain clean, well-documented, testable code and configuration that other admins/developers can support

CPQ & Quote-to-Cash Architecture (10%)
  

* Architect and maintain Salesforce CPQ configuration, including product catalog, pricing rules, approval workflows, and quote templates
* Design quote-to-cash process flows in partnership with Sales Operations and Finance
* Ensure CPQ architecture scales with evolving product lines, pricing models, and channel strategies
* Troubleshoot CPQ configuration issues and guide the business admin team on best practices

Data Architecture, Security & Governance (15%)
  

* Design and maintain the Salesforce data model, including object relationships, record types, and data lifecycle management
* Define and enforce security architecture: profiles, permission sets, role hierarchy, sharing rules, and field-level security
* Establish data governance standards, including deduplication, data quality rules, and archiving/retention policies
* Support compliance and audit activities related to Salesforce access, data handling, and change management
* Administer and govern DevOps/release management tooling (e.g., Salesforce DX, Gearset, Copado, or similar) and sandbox strategy

Production Support & Escalations (10%)
  

* Serve as the top-tier escalation point for complex Salesforce, integration, and CPQ issues that the business admin team cannot resolve
* Roll up sleeves to directly troubleshoot and resolve urgent, business-impacting production issues rather than deferring to others
* Triage and drive resolution of production incidents, coordinating with IT and business stakeholders as needed
* Maintain and improve runbooks and troubleshooting documentation based on recurring escalations
* Be responsive and available for critical, time-sensitive support needs outside of standard change requests

Collaboration & Stakeholder Management (5%)
  

* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for all Salesforce architecture decisions
* Liaise with the Natus Neuro IT team (TSA partner) on shared Salesforce systems, integrations, and escalated issues
* Mentor administrators and junior developers on platform best practices
* Communicate technical roadmaps, trade-offs, and risks clearly to non-technical stakeholders and leadership

**Travel Required:** Minimal; occasional travel for planning sessions or team meetings may be requested.
  
  
**QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS:**  

* Willingness to personally build and deploy enhancements, not just design and hand off to others
* 7+ years of hands-on Salesforce experience, including 3+ years in an architect-level role
* Demonstrated experience architecting solutions across Sales Cloud and Revenue Cloud
* Hands-on experience architecting and supporting Salesforce CPQ (product catalog, pricing, approvals, quote-to-cash)
* Proven experience designing and governing integrations between Salesforce and enterprise systems (ERP, middleware/iPaaS such as MuleSoft)
* Strong command of Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL/SOSL, and Salesforce declarative tools (Flow)
* Experience with Salesforce DevOps/release management practices and tools (Salesforce DX, version control, CI/CD pipelines)
* Ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into clear, scalable technical architecture
* Comfortable serving as a top-tier escalation point for urgent, complex issues and rolling up sleeves to resolve them directly
* Strong verbal and written communication skills; able to present architecture decisions to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Self-starter mentality: able to independently own architecture decisions and production issues with minimal oversight
* Immediate joiners or candidates with a notice period of up to 30 days preferred.

**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA), or actively pursuing the CTA credential
* Salesforce Certified Application Architect and/or System Architect
* Additional certifications: Sales Cloud Consultant, Service Cloud Consultant, CPQ Specialist, Platform Developer II
* Experience in a medical device, life sciences, or other regulated industry environment
* Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA as they relate to CRM data
* Experience integrating Salesforce with Oracle EBS or comparable ERP platforms
* Experience with Health Cloud or other industry-specific Salesforce clouds

Education and/or Experience
  
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and work experience. Salesforce architect-level certifications are highly valued and may substitute for formal education.
  
What We Offer
  

* Opportunity to own and shape Salesforce architecture for a growing medical device organization
* Competitive salary, commensurate with experience, with benefits package
* Exposure to enterprise integration architecture (Salesforce, ERP, MuleSoft/iPaaS) in a regulated industry.

**Compensation and Benefits:** Along with a competitive salary and performance-based incentives, we offer a comprehensive benefits package starting from day one, including medical insurance coverage for employees and their families, gratuity as per statutory norms, and paid time off in accordance with applicable labor laws.
  
  
Join Natus Sensory today. Confidence in every Sense.
  
  
**We offer:**  

* The role will start as a work-from-home remote position but will turn into a physical presence in an office role in Bangalore.
* Minimal travelling: less than 5%
* Collaborative and international environment with different cultures.
* English company language.
* Full ownership of testing of features and functionality.

EEO Statement
  
Natus Sensory is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status.

description:

At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy and that hasn’t happened by accident. Some of the best minds from diverse backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target’s global team and has more than 4,000 team members supporting the company’s global strategy and operations.

Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values diverse backgrounds. We believe your unique perspective is important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful. At Target, inclusion is part of the core value. We aim to create equitable experiences for all, regardless of their dimensions of difference. As an equal opportunity employer, Target provides diverse opportunities for everyone to grow and win

**Team Overview**

**Managed Kubernetes** is part of Target Infrastructure Services, providing the foundational container platform for deploying and operating applications across Target data centers and public cloud environments. The platform enables engineering teams to build and operate scalable, reliable services without having to manage the complexity of the underlying Kubernetes infrastructure. Through API- and UI-driven automation, teams can provision, upgrade, and manage Kubernetes clusters at scale across on-premises and cloud environments. The platform also provides curated capabilities for security, observability, compliance, and resiliency. By providing a consistent Kubernetes experience across Target data centers and public cloud, Managed Kubernetes reduces operational complexity, improves reliability, and accelerates application and platform development across Target.

**Position Overview**

We are looking for a **Lead Engineer – Kubernetes Platform** with extensive platform engineering experience in designing, building, automating, and operating cloud-native platforms. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Kubernetes, cloud-native technologies, and platform automation, with a strong focus on reliability, scalability, security, and operational excellence. This role will provide technical leadership in evolving our Kubernetes platform across hybrid cloud and on-premises environments.

**Required Skills**

* Strong software development experience in **Go (Golang)**.
* Extensive hands-on experience **designing, administering, and operating Kubernetes platforms, including cluster provisioning, configuration, upgrades, troubleshooting, and production operations.**
* Strong experience running Kubernetes on public cloud platforms. Experience with **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**and **Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)** is preferred; equivalent experience with AWS, Azure, or other public cloud platforms is also acceptable.
* Deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture and networking, including **CNI plugins, ingress controllers, services, network policies, load balancing, traffic routing, and service connectivity.**
* Experience with **Infrastructure as Code (IaC)** and Kubernetes deployment tools such as **Terraform**, **Helm**, and **Kustomize**.
* Experience implementing **GitOps** practices using tools such as **Argo CD** and/or **Flux**.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD automation and modern software delivery practices for Kubernetes platforms.
* Experience with **observability solutions, including metrics, logging, monitoring, alerting, distributed tracing, and platform reliability.**
* Experience administering Linux operating systems and optimizing container host environments.
* Experience with Kubernetes storage technologies, including CSI drivers, Persistent Volumes (PV), Persistent Volume Claims (PVC), Storage Classes, StatefulSets, and disaster recovery strategies.
* Strong automation-first mindset with experience managing infrastructure and platform services as code using version control, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code practices.
* Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) and/or Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) certification is a plus.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, build, automate, and operate Kubernetes platform services across hybrid cloud and on-premises environments.
* Develop platform tooling, controllers, and automation using Go (Golang).
* Design, implement, and manage GitOps and CI/CD workflows to automate application and infrastructure deployments across multi-cluster Kubernetes environments.
* Manage, optimize, and scale Kubernetes clusters, including Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), and the supporting cloud infrastructure.
* Drive platform observability, reliability, security, resiliency, and operational excellence.
* Lead platform initiatives including Kubernetes upgrades, cluster migrations, networking enhancements, storage architecture, scalability improvements, and platform modernization.
* Define platform architecture, engineering standards, and long-term technical strategy.
* Partner with engineering teams to deliver secure, scalable, resilient, and self-service cloud-native platform capabilities.
* Serve as a technical subject matter expert, mentor engineers, and influence engineering best practices across teams.
* Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to define platform roadmaps and balance product requirements with long-term platform sustainability.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10+ years of experience in software engineering, cloud engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, or a related field.
