title: IH Salesforce Production Support - Cigna Healthcare
description:
Technical Support Analyst
  
  
Position Information
  
  

* Job Title: Technical Support Analyst
* Function: Production Support / Salesforce Support
* Employment Type: Full-time
* Location: Bangalore
* Reports To: Cloud Support Manager

Role Purpose
  
  
The Technical Support Analyst is a hands-on member of the Production Support team, responsible for supporting and maintaining Salesforce applications used across Cigna International Health.
  
  
The primary focus of the role is day-to-day Salesforce administration across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud, including user lifecycle management, access and permissions, declarative configuration, data maintenance, reporting, and operational support. The role also investigates and manages application incidents through ServiceNow, working with business users, technical teams, and senior support colleagues to restore service, meet agreed service levels, and provide a high standard of customer support.
  
The successful candidate will work with appropriate autonomy, prioritize their workload, and deliver accurate, controlled, and well-documented outcomes. They will escalate work requiring development, architecture decisions, elevated privileges, or higher-risk production changes.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Salesforce Administration and User Access
  
  

* Create, update, activate, freeze, and deactivate Salesforce users in accordance with approved access requests and user lifecycle procedures.
* Maintain user access through profiles, roles, permission sets, permission set groups, licenses, queues, public groups, and other approved access mechanisms.
* Investigate and resolve common login, visibility, permission, object-access, field-access, and record-access issues.
* Maintain access hygiene by reviewing assignments, identifying inappropriate or obsolete access, and supporting periodic access reviews.
* Apply least-privilege and segregation-of-duties principles, escalating privileged, unusual, or high-risk access requests to the appropriate security, identity-management, or senior Salesforce resource.
* Maintain clear evidence of approvals and completed access changes where required for audit or control purposes.

Declarative Configuration and Platform Maintenance
  
  

* Configure and maintain Salesforce using approved declarative, “clicks-not-code” capabilities.
* Support routine changes to standard and custom objects, fields, page layouts, record types, list views, queues, assignment rules, validation rules, reports, dashboards, and other administrative configurations.
* Assist with basic Salesforce Flow configuration and troubleshooting where the requirement is within the role’s approved administrative scope.
* Perform configuration and operational support across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud.
* Validate changes in an appropriate lower environment before production implementation, following established testing, approval, deployment, and post-implementation validation procedures.
* Monitor the impact of routine Salesforce releases and support low-risk readiness or validation activities.
* Escalate requirements involving Apex, Lightning Web Components, complex integrations, architecture changes, or development-intensive solutions.

Data Maintenance and Reporting
  
  

* Maintain Salesforce data accurately and securely, including approved record creation, updates, corrections, ownership changes, and controlled bulk activities.
* Support data imports, exports, and mass updates using authorized tools and documented procedures.
* Complete appropriate validation and reconciliation before and after data changes.
* Identify duplicate, incomplete, obsolete, or inconsistent information and work with data owners to improve data quality.
* Create and maintain standard reports and dashboards to support operational and business requirements.
* Protect sensitive information and avoid unapproved data deletion, extraction, or other high-risk data activity.
* Maintain traceable records of approvals, test results, data files, outcomes, and rollback information where required.

Incident and Application Support
  
  

* Monitor and manage incidents and support requests assigned through ServiceNow.
* Review ticket information, confirm the reported symptoms and business impact, and gather any additional information required to investigate the issue.
* Validate that the correct application or configuration item is recorded and ensure the incident is assigned to the appropriate support group.
* Investigate common Salesforce and supported application issues, including user access, permissions, configuration, data, workflow, and functional errors.
* Reproduce issues where appropriate, review available documentation and known issues, and identify a resolution, workaround, or appropriate escalation path.
* Maintain accurate ticket states and remain aware of applicable responses and resolution of SLAs.
* Record meaningful internal investigation details, actions taken, dependencies, and escalation of information in work notes.
* Provide clear and timely customer updates through the appropriate customer-visible ServiceNow fields.
* Reassign incidents promptly when another team is required, documenting the reason for reassignment.
* Complete accurate resolution information and clear resolution notes before resolving a ticket.
* Escalate major, high-impact, recurring, security-related, or technically complex incidents in accordance with established support procedures.

Documentation, Automation, and Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Create and maintain clear operational documentation, runbooks, support procedures, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge articles.
* Identify repetitive, manual, or error-prone activities that may be suitable for controlled automation.
* Contribute to the design, testing, documentation, and ongoing monitoring of low-risk automation solutions.
* Recommend improvements that increase support efficiency, data quality, customer experience, control effectiveness, or service reliability.

Collaboration and Customer Service
  
  

* Work effectively with geographically distributed colleagues across business, production support, identity and access management, security, product, engineering, and development teams.
* Translate technical issues into clear, practical information for both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Manage assigned work with appropriate autonomy, balancing priorities, risk, business impact, and SLA commitments.
* Provide accurate, professional, and customer-focused communication throughout requests and incidents.
* Seek guidance when requirements are unclear and escalate promptly when an issue exceeds the role’s authority or technical scope.

Required Skills and Experience
  
  

* Minimum of three years of professional experience working as a Salesforce Administrator.
* Practical administration experience across:
* Sales Cloud
* Service Cloud
* Experience Cloud
* Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce user provisioning, deactivation, access management, profiles, roles, permission sets, permission set groups, licenses, queues, and public groups.
* Experience configuring standard and custom objects, fields, page layouts, record types, list views, validation rules, assignment rules, reports, and dashboards.
* Experience with declarative Salesforce administration and basic Flow configuration or troubleshooting.
* Experience performing controlled data imports, exports, corrections, bulk updates, and data-quality activities.
* Demonstrated experience supporting production applications and investigating user, access, configuration, data, and functional issues.
* Ability to maintain accurate technical documentation, ticket records, change evidence, and audit trails.
* Strong attention to detail and a disciplined approach to security, data protection, operational risk, and change control.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Ability to prioritize assigned work, work independently within defined procedures, and recognize when escalation is required.

Preferred or Desirable Skills
  
  

* Working knowledge of ServiceNow, including incident handling, work notes, customer updates, resolution information, and SLA awareness.
* Salesforce Certified Administrator credential.
* Experience supporting Salesforce in a health insurance, healthcare or other regulated environment.
* Experience with access reviews, audit evidence, segregation-of-duties controls, or identity and access management processes.
* Familiarity with Agile delivery, Jira, Confluence, knowledge management, release-readiness activities, user acceptance testing, and smoke testing.
* Exposure to application-monitoring or log-analysis tools such as Dynatrace or Splunk.
* Experience identifying opportunities to automate recurring administrative or support activities.

Behaviors and Competencies
  
  

* Customer focused: Provides responsive, accurate, and professional support.
* Team player: Collaborates openly across geographic, business, and technical boundaries.
* Problem solver: Investigates methodically and uses evidence to reach sound conclusions.
* Autonomous: Takes ownership of assigned work while escalating appropriately.
* Process minded: Follows documented controls and maintains complete, traceable records.
* Security and risk aware: Protects access, data, system stability, and audit integrity.
* Curious and adaptable: Learns unfamiliar applications and business processes confidently.
* Continuous-improvement driven: Challenges inefficient manual processes and proposes safe, practical improvements.
* Clear communicator: Explains technical matters effectively to different audiences.
* Dependable: Manages priorities and delivers work to agreed time and quality expectations.

Scope of the Role
  
  
This is primarily a Salesforce administration and production-support position, not a Salesforce developer or solution-architect role. The analyst is expected to complete routine declarative configuration and operational support independently within approved procedures. Custom development, complex integration work, architecture decisions, privileged actions, and high-risk production changes must be referred to the appropriate senior administrator, engineering, architecture, security, or development team.
  
Measures of Success
  
  
**Success in the position will be demonstrated through:**  

* Timely and accurate completion of user lifecycle and access requests.
* Achievement of applicable incident and request SLAs.
* High-quality investigation notes, customer communications, and resolution records.
* Secure, accurate, and controlled Salesforce configuration and data maintenance.
* Complete change, approval, testing, and audit evidence.
* Effective escalation of work outside administrative scope.
* Current, usable operational documentation and knowledge articles.
* Measurable contribution to automation, process improvement, and reduced recurring support efforts.

About The Cigna Group
  
  
Cigna Healthcare, a division of The Cigna Group, is an advocate for better health through every stage of life. We guide our customers through the health care system, empowering them with the information and insight they need to make the best choices for improving their health and vitality. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

- Mentor junior team members and provide technical guidance throughout the delivery lifecycle.

- Contribute to Agile ceremonies, planning activities, estimation, and delivery tracking.

- Experience supporting sustainability, ESG, carbon accounting, or Net Zero programs.

- Knowledge of Salesforce Net Zero Cloud.

- Strong functional knowledge of Salesforce implementations and business analysis.

- Hands-on experience with:

- Lightning Web Components

- SOQL and SOSL

- Salesforce Flows

- Salesforce integrations and APIs

- Experience working in Agile delivery environments.

- Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, architects, developers, and delivery teams.

- Strong communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

- Proven ability to work across complex, large-scale enterprise programs.

- Experience with MuleSoft or other integration and middleware platforms.

- Salesforce certifications, such as:

- Platform Developer I or II

- Salesforce Administrator

- Platform App Builder

- Architect-level certifications

- Salesforce certifications.

## Ideal Candidate

The successful candidate combines deep Salesforce technical expertise with strong functional and consulting capabilities. They can move comfortably between business discussions, solution architecture, hands-on development, and delivery leadership, while maintaining a focus on quality, scalability, security, and business value.

## How You’ll Grow

At Deloitte, we’ve invested a great deal in creating a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. We want all our people to develop in their own way, playing to their own strengths as they hone their leadership skills, and as a part of our efforts, we provide our professionals with a variety of learning and networking opportunities—including exposure to leaders, sponsors, coaches, and challenging assignments—to help accelerate their careers along the way.

## Deloitte’s Culture

Our positive and supportive culture encourages our people to do their best work every day. We celebrate individuals by recognizing their uniqueness and offering them the flexibility to make daily choices that can help them to be healthy, centered, confident, and aware.

We offer well-being programs and are continuously looking for new ways to maintain a culture that is inclusive, invites authenticity, leverages our diversity, and where our people excel and lead healthy, happy lives.

description:

You will help lead Levi Strauss & Co.’s 24/7 global IT Command Center operations and serve in the Manager on Duty rotation for high-impact technology events. This role coordinates major-incident response, drives service restoration, governs enterprise change activity through Change Advisory Board processes, and strengthens Incident, Problem, Change Management, and Disaster Recovery readiness. * 6 to 8 years of experience in IT operations or support, with demonstrated leadership across Incident, Problem, and Change Management in production environments.

* Clear executive, technical, and business communication skills, with the ability to coordinate teams and make time-sensitive decisions during high-impact events.
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Nice to have**

* ITIL certification.
* ServiceNow Administrator or ITSM certification.
* Experience with monitoring and event-management platforms, automation integration, Disaster Recovery exercises, and managed-service-provider SLA management.

This role supports a global 24/7/365 operating model and participates in a Manager on Duty rotation. description:
Atos is the Atos Group brand dedicated to AI-powered, secure, end-to-end digital services. Atos designs, develops, and operates critical digital environments that drive performance, resilience and sovereignty, helping public and private organizations worldwide retain control over their data and infrastructures, while meeting regulatory requirements.

  

With more than 52,000 employees serving over 4,500 clients across 54 countries, Atos helps modernize core IT systems, accelerate cloud and data transformation, strengthen cybersecurity, and deliver secure digital workplace environments to support its clients, its employees and society. Atos also provides consulting and advisory services through its Atos Amplify brand.  
A trusted partner in operating complex and mission-critical environments, Atos supports organizations across highly regulated and sovereign contexts.

  

**About Atos Group**

Atos Group is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 54,000 employees and annual revenue of c. €7.2 billion, operating in 54 countries under two brands - Atos for services and Eviden for products and systems. European number one in cybersecurity and a leader in cloud, Atos Group is committed to a secure and decarbonized future and provides tailored AI-powered, end-to-end solutions for all industries. Atos Group is listed on Euronext Paris.

  

**Work Location**: Bengaluru

**Experience**: 5+ Years

  

**Role Overview**

Okta Support Consultant Primary Focus Okta operations, application integration, authentication security, and production support.

The Okta Support Consultant is responsible for providing operational and engineering support for the enterprise workforce identity environment.

The role focuses on maintaining secure and reliable authentication services, resolving incidents, implementing approved changes, onboarding applications, supporting identity lifecycle processes, and continuously improving operational controls.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Administer and support Okta Workforce Identity, including users, groups, application assignments, policies, roles, and tenant settings. Monitor Okta platform health, authentication events, MFA activity, agent status, and security alerts to ensure service reliability.
* Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot application integrations using SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM, APIs, and provisioning technologies.
* Support MFA and passwordless authentication solutions, including Okta Verify, FastPass, Adaptive MFA, and phishing-resistant authentication.
* Manage user access lifecycle activities, including provisioning, deprovisioning, profile updates, entitlement management, and license optimization.
* Monitor and troubleshoot AD, LDAP, RADIUS integrations, directory synchronization, delegated authentication, and provisioning processes.
* Investigate and resolve complex authentication, federation, provisioning, certificate, and application access issues.
* Support critical incidents, perform containment actions, coordinate with stakeholders, and contribute to root cause analysis and remediation.
* Execute production changes through approved change management processes, ensuring proper planning, testing, implementation, validation, and communication.

  

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 5+ years of IAM experience, including 3+ years of hands-on Okta administration, engineering, or production support.
* Strong knowledge of Okta Workforce Identity, SSO, MFA, Universal Directory, authentication policies, and lifecycle management.
* Hands-on experience with SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM, REST APIs, JIT provisioning, federation, and certificate management.
* Experience supporting Active Directory, LDAP, RADIUS, delegated authentication, and identity integrations.
* Proficiency in troubleshooting authentication and provisioning issues using Okta and related system logs.

* Experience with incident, problem, request, and change management in ITSM environments.
* Ability to create and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, knowledge articles, and audit records.

title: Salesforce Billing Administrator - 26133D
description:
**Salesforce Billing Administrator**

**Location:** Bangalore (Hybrid)  
**Working hours:** 2:00pm to 11:00pm with occasional night shifts (during revenue close periods)

**Why YOU want this position**  
  
At Enverus, we’re committed to empowering the global quality of life by helping our customers make energy affordable and accessible to the world.  
  
We are the most trusted energy-dedicated SaaS company, with a platform built to maximize value from generative AI, and our innovative solutions are reshaping the way energy is consumed and managed. By offering anytime, anywhere access to analytics and insights, we’re helping our customers make better decisions that help provide communities around the world with clean, affordable energy.  
  
The energy industry is changing fast. But we’ve continued to lead the way in energy technology, creating intelligent connections across the entire energy ecosystem, from renewables, power and utilities, to oil and gas and financial institutions. Our solutions create more efficient production and distribution, capital allocation, renewable energy development, investment and sourcing, and help reduce costs by automating crucial business operations. Of course, this wouldn’t be possible without our people, which is why we have built a team of individuals from a diverse range of backgrounds.  
  
Are you ready to help power the global quality of life? Join Enverus, and be a part of creating a brighter, more sustainable tomorrow.

**About the Role**  
As a Salesforce Billing Administrator, you will support and maintain the day-to-day operations of our Revenue Cloud environment, working closely with Salesforce Billing consultants and the Global Revenue Team. You will investigate and resolve billing cases, manage configurations, and ensure data accuracy across billing processes. This role is ideal for someone with hands-on CPQ and Billing experience who enjoys troubleshooting complex issues, improving system reliability, and partnering with global teams in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

**Performance Objectives**

* Hands-on experience implementing Salesforce Billing, including Contract Renewal, amendments, Subscriptions, Billing Rules, Tax rules, invoice scheduler and Payment.
* Work alongside Salesforce Billing consultants to understand the existing implementation, recurring issues, and system architecture — then take progressive ownership of day-to-day support.
* Investigate and resolve Salesforce Billing cases; identify root causes of recurring issues and apply permanent fixes.
* Manage Revenue Cloud configurations — billing rules, invoice schedules, and product setup.
* Build and maintain custom reports and dashboards for the Global Revenue Team.
* Set up and maintain invoice templates using Conga.
* Perform database maintenance — diagnostic testing, duplicate cleansing, and data quality governance.
* Resolve Sales Tax issues and maintain compliance with billing records.
* Provide end-user training and support for billing processes and new releases.
* Hands-on experience in flows.
* Experience across the SDLC, including Agile methodologies, sandbox-based development, and deployment best practices.
* This role requires flexibility to support night shifts during revenue close periods or when global team coverage is needed.
* Attend team meetings via video call with camera on.

**Competitive Candidate Profile**

* 2–4 years of hands-on Salesforce Administration experience in Billing
* Thorough understanding of Quote to cash process.
* Understanding of Salesforce CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote).
* Hands-on experience with declarative Salesforce tools (Flows, validation rules, reports & dashboards).
* Good communication skills; comfortable working with global teams over video calls.

**Education & Certifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Salesforce Certified Administrator — required.
* Additional certifications (Platform App Builder, Billing Specialist, CPQ Specialist) are a plus.

title: CRM Customer Data Steward
description:
**At Bayer we’re visionaries, driven to solve the world’s toughest challenges and striving for a world where ,Health for all, Hunger for none’ is no longer a dream, but a real possibility. We’re doing it with energy, curiosity and sheer dedication, always learning from unique perspectives of those around us, expanding our thinking, growing our capabilities and redefining ‘impossible’. There are so many reasons to join us. If you’re hungry to build a varied and meaningful career in a community of brilliant and diverse minds to make a real difference, there’s only one choice.**

  


**CRM Customer Data Steward**

 **POSITION PURPOSE:**



The CRM Customer Data Steward is a hands\-on business data stewardship role responsible for ensuring that customer data in CRM is trusted, complete, well\-structured, governed, and ready for commercial use, analytics, automation, and AI\-enabled customer engagement. The role focuses on improving the quality and usability of CRM customer data across markets, platforms, and customer\-facing processes.



This role owns the day\-to\-day stewardship routines for CRM customer data, including business definitions, metadata, data quality checks, issue triage, remediation follow\-up, glossary management, and process documentation. It ensures that customer records, account hierarchies, contact data, segmentation attributes, consent and preference data, interaction data, and CRM process data are managed consistently and can be reused across reporting, Customer360, field\-force effectiveness, personalization, and AI\-supported use cases.



The role is forward\-looking and automation\-minded. It does not only maintain CRM data; it continuously improves how CRM processes work. This includes identifying manual steps, recurring data quality issues, duplicate work, approval bottlenecks, exception handling gaps, and reporting friction — then translating these into practical improvements, workflow automation opportunities, AI\-enabled support, and scalable stewardship practices.



As CRM becomes more connected with customer engagement, commercial execution, analytics, and AI, this role strengthens the data foundation needed for better decisions and better customer interactions. It helps ensure that CRM data is not only correct, but also understandable, connected, explainable, compliant, and ready to power future capabilities such as Customer360, next\-best\-action, AI\-assisted field\-force planning, automated data quality controls, and conversational analytics.

  


**YOUR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**


* Own CRM customer data stewardship routines, ensuring customer data in CRM is accurate, complete, consistent, timely, compliant, and fit for business use across markets, customer\-facing teams, and connected systems.
* Improve CRM data quality end\-to\-end by monitoring completeness, duplication, consistency, timeliness, usability, and business relevance across customer accounts, contacts, hierarchies, segmentation attributes, consent indicators, interaction data, and related CRM objects.
* Lead day\-to\-day CRM customer data operations, including data creation, maintenance, enrichment, correction, validation, approval workflows, duplicate resolution, controlled retirement, and issue resolution.
* Define, maintain, and enforce CRM customer data standards, including business definitions, required fields, metadata, glossary terms, validation rules, account hierarchies, customer classifications, ownership rules, and source\-system references.
* Own CRM metadata and glossary management, ensuring key customer data elements, definitions, ownership, quality rules, lineage, and approved business terminology are documented and consistently understood by business and technical teams.
* Establish and manage CRM data quality monitoring, including scorecards, KPIs, service levels, dashboards, issue logs, root\-cause analysis, remediation tracking, and continuous improvement actions.
* Act as the lead escalation point for CRM customer data issues by assessing business impact, prioritizing defects, coordinating resolution, communicating risks, and preventing recurring problems through sustainable process or system fixes.
* Translate CRM business requirements into executable data rules, validation logic, workflow steps, approval processes, exception handling, and issue\-resolution playbooks.
* Identify and drive opportunities to simplify, standardize, and automate CRM processes, including manual data entry, data validation, duplicate detection, enrichment workflows, approval routing, exception handling, quality checks, and stewardship reporting.
* Partner with CRM product owners, business teams, Sales, Customer Engagement, Commercial Excellence, eCommerce, analytics, IT, data engineering, privacy, security, and local market teams to align CRM data capabilities with business priorities and priority use cases.
* Support the design and continuous improvement of CRM customer data models, customer hierarchies, segmentation frameworks, Customer360, field\-force reporting, customer engagement insights, and enterprise customer master data capabilities.
* Ensure CRM data is ready for AI\-enabled use cases by improving business context, metadata, semantic definitions, consent awareness, data quality rules, and explainability of customer data used in analytics, automation, and AI tools.
* Support AI\-enabled CRM transformation by helping define the data foundations required for next\-best\-action, AI\-assisted customer planning, conversational analytics, automated recommendations, customer prioritization, and more intelligent field\-force workflows.
* Coordinate onboarding and integration of new CRM customer data sources and datasets, ensuring validation, testing, governance approval, documentation, process alignment, and stakeholder adoption.
* Manage stewardship activities across global and local teams, ensuring consistent use of CRM data definitions, business rules, quality standards, issue\-management processes, and responsible data usage.
* Work with internal and external data providers, CRM implementation partners, technology vendors, system integrators, and managed service teams to ensure reliable, documented, high\-quality, and sustainable CRM data delivery.
* Act as the business\-side quality gate for externally delivered CRM data work, including cleansing, enrichment, matching, migration, automation, dashboarding, and governance deliverables.
* Train and enable local data stewards, CRM administrators, business users, and customer\-facing teams on CRM data standards, stewardship routines, issue handling, data quality expectations, and responsible use of AI\-enabled tools.
* Communicate CRM data updates, quality issues, governance changes, risks, decisions, automation opportunities, and improvement actions clearly to stakeholders and user communities.
* Enable CRM data products, Customer360, analytics, AI initiatives, personalization, reporting, and data\-driven decision\-making by ensuring CRM customer data is trusted, explainable, connected, and ready to use.

  


**WHO YOU ARE:**


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Management, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Business Administration, Computer Science, Commercial Operations, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in CRM data stewardship, customer data management, CRM operations, master data management, data quality, business analysis, data governance, or commercial data operations.
* Strong understanding of CRM customer data concepts, including account and contact data, customer identifiers, account hierarchies, customer segmentation, consent and preference data, interaction history, territories, field\-force data, deduplication, match\-and\-merge, survivorship, and golden records.
* Practical experience with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, Veeva, IQVIA OCE, CustomerTimes, BayTouch, Asseco, or comparable CRM solutions; experience with MDM platforms such as SAP MDG, Informatica, Reltio, TIBCO EBX, or comparable tools is an advantage.
* Strong knowledge of data stewardship and data governance practices, including data ownership, stewardship routines, metadata management, business glossaries, data quality KPIs, issue triage, lineage, access, privacy, consent, and change control.
* Experience improving CRM processes through standardization, automation, workflow redesign, better controls, clearer ownership, and more scalable operating routines.
* Ability to translate business needs and CRM pain points into clear data standards, business rules, process requirements, validation logic, automation opportunities, and operational workflows.
* Hands\-on experience with data analysis, issue investigation, data quality reporting, and root\-cause analysis; familiarity with SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Excel, Snowflake, Databricks, or comparable tools is an advantage.
* AI\-curious and automation\-minded, with a practical understanding of how CRM data structure, metadata, business context, consent, and quality influence analytics, machine learning, generative AI, and AI\-assisted business workflows.
* Good understanding of how CRM customer data supports Customer360, customer engagement, field\-force effectiveness, segmentation, personalization, next\-best\-action, commercial reporting, and AI\-enabled decision support.
* Experience working with external partners, CRM vendors, system integrators, data providers, or managed service teams, with the ability to define requirements, challenge quality, validate outputs, and ensure sustainable handover.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across global, regional, and local teams and explain CRM data issues clearly to non\-technical business users.
* Structured, detail\-oriented, pragmatic, and delivery\-focused, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, lead issue resolution, and drive continuous improvement.
* Fluent English required; additional languages are a plus.

description:
**Salesforce Identity \& Access Management Analyst (IAM)**

**Location:** Pune or Bangalore

**Shift:** EMEA Hours (GMT)


As a Salesforce Identity \& Access Management (IAM) Analyst, you will be responsible for ensuring users have the appropriate access to Salesforce systems throughout their lifecycle while maintaining compliance with security, governance, and audit requirements

**What you will do**

* Provision, modify, and deprovision Salesforce user accounts in line with approved access requests, policies, and SLAs.
* Manage user onboarding, offboarding, transfers, and role changes across multiple Salesforce environments.
* Administer Salesforce profiles, permission sets, permission set groups, roles, public groups, queues, and sharing models.
* Perform access reviews and recertification activities to ensure users have appropriate access based on business need and least\-privilege principles.
* Investigate and resolve user access issues, authentication problems, and security\-related incidents.
* Process and track requests through ServiceNow maintaining accurate records of access requests, approvals, and audit evidence.
* Develop and maintain IAM procedures, work instructions, and operational documentation.

**How you will do it**

* Follow established security, governance, and approval processes, ensuring that all access changes are accurately documented and auditable.
* Communicate effectively with users and stakeholders regarding requests and access requirements.
* Maintain a high level of accuracy while managing a large volume of requests.
* Identify opportunities to automate access management processes and improve service delivery.

**What we look for**

* 2\+ years of Salesforce Administration experience with a focus on user provisioning and access management.
* Salesforce Administrator Certification (required).
* Strong understanding of Salesforce security and access model including Profiles, Permission Sets, Roles, Public Groups, and Queues.
* Experience using ITSM tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, or similar platforms.
* Understanding of Identity and Access Management principles, including least privilege, role\-based access control (RBAC), and user lifecycle management.
* Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Fluent English (must).

* Direct ownership of a client relationship, not a back\-seat delivery role

**Apply now** if you can be on\-site in Bengaluru or Hyderabad and want to own F5 XC delivery end to end.

title: IT Administration
description:
Job Description – IT Administrator

**Job Title:** IT Administrator  
**Department:** IT / Administration  
**Location:** Bengaluru  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Reporting To:** Head of Operations / HR / Management

About the Role

We are looking for a hands\-on **IT Administrator** to manage and support the company’s day\-to\-day IT infrastructure, systems, devices, user access, and IT security.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in a fast\-paced startup environment and should be able to independently troubleshoot issues, manage IT assets, coordinate with vendors, and ensure employees have the required systems and access to perform their work efficiently.

Key Responsibilities1\. IT Infrastructure \& Support

* Manage day\-to\-day IT operations and provide technical support to employees.
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, network, Wi\-Fi, printer, and other IT\-related issues.
* Maintain office IT infrastructure including routers, switches, access points, printers, UPS, and other equipment.
* Monitor system and network performance and coordinate with service providers when required.
* Maintain proper documentation of IT infrastructure, configurations, and vendors.

2\. Laptop \& IT Asset Management

* Manage the complete lifecycle of company laptops, desktops, monitors, peripherals, and other IT assets.
* Maintain an updated IT asset inventory and asset allocation records.
* Configure and deploy laptops and systems for new employees.
* Ensure proper collection, inspection, and secure wiping of devices during employee exits.
* Coordinate repairs, warranty claims, AMC, and replacement of IT equipment.
* Implement appropriate controls to prevent loss or misuse of company assets.

3\. User \& Access Management

* Create, modify, and deactivate employee accounts and system access.
* Manage access to email, Google Workspace/Microsoft 365, Slack, HRMS, cloud applications, and other business tools.
* Ensure access is provided based on role and business requirements.
* Immediately revoke access for employees leaving the organisation.
* Conduct periodic access reviews and maintain proper access records.

4\. IT Security

* Implement and maintain basic IT security controls across company systems.
* Ensure laptops and systems have appropriate antivirus/endpoint protection and security updates.
* Support password, MFA, device security, and access\-control practices.
* Monitor and report suspicious activities, security incidents, or unauthorised access.
* Work with external cybersecurity vendors/consultants when required.
* Conduct periodic security awareness initiatives for employees.

5\. Vendor \& Service Provider Management

* Coordinate with internet service providers, hardware vendors, software vendors, and IT support partners.
* Evaluate quotations and assist with procurement of IT equipment and software.
* Track IT contracts, AMC, warranties, subscriptions, and renewals.
* Ensure timely resolution of vendor\-related issues.

6\. IT Policies \& Documentation

* Develop and maintain IT policies, SOPs, and guidelines.
* Maintain records for IT assets, software licenses, user access, and IT incidents.
* Support implementation of company policies related to information security and acceptable use of IT resources.
* Assist HR and management during employee onboarding and offboarding.

7\. Backup \& Business Continuity

* Ensure appropriate backup processes are implemented for critical company data and systems.
* Periodically verify backup availability and restoration processes.
* Support disaster recovery and business continuity planning.

Onboarding \& Offboarding

The IT Administrator will work closely with **HR and department heads** to ensure:

**Employee Onboarding**

* Laptop/system allocation
* Email and application account creation
* Access provisioning
* Basic IT orientation
* Asset acknowledgement

**Employee Offboarding**

* Disable all user accounts and access
* Recover laptops and IT assets
* Transfer/secure company data
* Revoke application and cloud access
* Update asset and access records

Requirements

* Bachelor's degree/diploma in IT, Computer Science, or a related field.
* **2–5 years of experience** in IT administration, IT support, or system administration.
* Strong knowledge of Windows/macOS operating systems.
* Good understanding of networking, Wi\-Fi, VPN, DNS, DHCP, and troubleshooting.
* Experience with Google Workspace or Microsoft 365\.
* Experience in laptop/device and IT asset management.
* Basic understanding of cybersecurity and endpoint security.
* Good vendor\-management and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and resolve issues quickly.

Preferred Skills

* Experience with an early\-stage/startup environment.
* Experience managing cloud\-based applications and SaaS tools.
* Knowledge of MDM solutions such as Google Endpoint Management, Microsoft Intune, Jamf, or similar.
* Basic knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS/Azure/GCP.
* Familiarity with IT security frameworks and best practices.
* Experience implementing IT policies and access\-control processes.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* IT issues resolved within defined timelines.
* System and network uptime.
* Accurate IT asset inventory.
* Timely onboarding/offboarding access management.
* Timely renewal of IT licenses and subscriptions.
* Reduction in recurring IT issues.
* Compliance with IT security policies.
* Employee satisfaction with IT support.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who is **hands\-on, proactive, organised, security\-conscious, and comfortable taking ownership** of the company's IT operations. The person should be able to work independently, prioritise multiple requests, and build scalable IT processes as the organisation grows.

**About G2 \- The Company**  

  



G2 is the world's largest and most trusted software marketplace. When you join G2, you’re joining the industry’s leading team that helps businesses reach their peak potential by powering decisions and strategies with trusted insights from real software users.


Now, we have joined forces with Capterra, SoftwareAdvice, and GetApp to create the largest source of online data and software insights to fuel intelligent buying in the age of AI. With 200M\+ combined annual visitors and 6M verified reviews, we are now the centralized place to enable software buyers to make better and faster decisions with confidence.


And we are just getting started! We are setting out to transform the global B2B software industry and become the most trusted data foundation for buyers and sellers of software for the age of AI.


Does that sound exciting to you? Come join us as we try to reach our next PEAK!


**About G2 \- Our People**


At G2, everything we are and what we do is grounded in our PEAK values— (*P*erformance \+ *E*ntrepreneurship \+ *A*uthenticity \+ *K*indness. Working at G2 means you are part of a value\-driven, growing global community that climbs PEAKs together. We cheer for each other’s successes, learn from our mistakes, and support and lean on one another during challenging times. With ambition and entrepreneurial spirit we push each other to take on challenging work, which will help us all to grow and learn.


You will be part of a global, diverse team of smart, dedicated, and kind individuals \- each with unique talents, aspirations, and life experiences. At the heart of our community and culture are our people\-led ERGs, which celebrate and highlight the diverse identities of our global team. As an organization, we are intentional about our DEI and philanthropic work (like our G2 Gives program) because it encourages us all to be better people.


**About The Role:**
-------------------


G2 is looking for a Salesforce Engineer based in Bangalore, India to serve as the primary technical partner embedded with our sales and revenue\-facing business stakeholders, someone who can move fluidly from a conversation about pipeline OKRs to writing Apex code to shipping a solution in production.


This is a hybrid role based out of our Bangalore office for regular in\-person collaboration.It is a high\-autonomy, high\-ownership role. You are the engineer, the analyst, the architect, and the delivery owner. You will operate across Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, and Revenue Accounting to understand what they need, design the right solution, build it, test it, deploy it, and iterate on it. If you thrive in environments where you can see the direct impact of what you build on the revenue teams depending on it every day and where you're expected to bring both technical depth and business judgment, this role is for you.


**In This Role, You Will Focus On:**
------------------------------------


* Partnering directly with Sales, Marketing, Partner, and Revenue Accounting stakeholders including collaborating across time zones with G2's US\-based teams to understand goals, OKRs, and process friction, translating them into technical solutions without a PM or BSA intermediary
* Owning the full delivery lifecycle: requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and ongoing iteration
* Building and maintaining solutions across G2's revenue tech stack, including Salesforce (Sales Cloud, CPQ), Gong, ZoomInfo, and Slack and evaluating new tools as the GTM ecosystem evolves
* Developing within Salesforce using both declarative configuration and custom code writing Apex classes, triggers, and Lightning Web Components (LWC) for solutions that go beyond what clicks can deliver
* Designing and deploying AI\-powered GTM workflows leveraging Claude Code, Dust, and native AI capabilities within the stack to automate and augment how Sales and Marketing teams operate, from lead routing to pipeline hygiene to revenue recognition support
* Maintaining the reliability, performance, and governance of the systems you own including documentation, change management, and proactive monitoring

**Minimum Qualifications:**
---------------------------


We realize applying for jobs can feel daunting at times. Even if you don’t check all the boxes in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.


* 8\+ years of experience in a Salesforce\-centric technical role, with demonstrated ownership of solution delivery end\-to\-end
* Salesforce development proficiency: Apex (classes, triggers, batch jobs), Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL, and platform configuration (flows, validation rules, page layouts, permission sets)
* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce CPQ including quote configuration, pricing rules, approval workflows, and order management
* Experience working directly with Sales and Marketing business stakeholders comfortable running discovery conversations, scoping solutions, and managing delivery expectations without a PM layer
* Familiarity with one or more tools in the revenue tech ecosystem: Gong, ZoomInfo, or comparable GTM platforms
* Demonstrated ability to operate without a PM or QA function you write your own test cases, own your own deployments, and catch your own bugs
* Comfort with AI\-assisted development workflows and genuine curiosity about applying LLMs and AI agents to Sales and Marketing operations
* Strong written and verbal communication able to collaborate effectively across time zones with US\-based stakeholders and explain technical decisions to non\-technical business partners
* Must be based in Bangalore, India or within commutable distance to the Bangalore office

**What Can Help Your Application Stand Out:**
---------------------------------------------


* Experience with Salesforce integration patterns (REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, named credentials)
* Exposure to AI workflow automation tools (Claude Code, Dust, n8n, or similar)
* Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II, CPQ Specialist, Administrator, Advanced Administrator)
* Prior experience supporting Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Marketing Operations in a B2B SaaS environment
* Experience working in a global team with cross\-timezone collaboration, particularly with North America\-based stakeholders

**Our Commitment to Inclusivity and Diversity**


At G2, we are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment where people of every background can thrive and feel welcome. We consider applicants without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, genetic information, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, or marital, veteran, or physical or mental disability status.


\-

G2 incorporates AI\-powered technology to enhance our candidate evaluation process. These tools may assist with initial application screening, skills assessment analysis, and identifying candidates whose qualifications align with specific role requirements. While AI technology supports our recruitment workflow, all final hiring decisions remain under human oversight and judgment.

Choosing to opt out will not disadvantage your application in any way—we will ensure your materials receive a thorough manual review by our hiring team.

description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**  

  

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real\-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.  

  

This is an opportunity to do career\-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

**Senior UX Researcher**
**Role Located out of:** Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

  

**The Overview**



At Okta, we’re building a world where anyone can safely use any technology, and we’re specifically focused on protecting the future of work. We bring simple and secure access to people and organizations everywhere, promising to not only protect the identities of our workforce and users but to ask, “what more can we make possible?”



As a Senior UX Researcher at Okta India, you will join a globally distributed research and design team, shaping customer experiences across the Access Management ecosystem. Your mission is to secure workforce access right from physical device bootup delivering frictionless, phishing resistant, and passwordless authentication across macOS, Windows,Linux, iOS, and Android platforms.



In this role, you will lead end to end research initiatives, translating ambiguous product questions into actionable insights that directly influence long term strategy and near term product decisions across global Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) teams.


**Finer Print**
---------------



You will join an AI first team of researchers and designers supported by leadership who fosters high autonomy, deep ownership, and a strong culture of craft. As part of Okta’s centralized Design \& Research organization in Bengaluru, you will act as a key research anchor, working closely with cross functional partners in both India and the US to define problems, explore solutions, and drive impact.



You will balance functional, foundational research with generative explorations that help frame new security and identity paradigms in an evolving, technical problem space.


**What You Will Do**
--------------------



As the dedicated User Researcher for Access Management in India, you will own the UX research strategy along with an opportunity to act as a foundational builder for our regional research operations.


* **Own Access Management Research in India:** Scope, prioritize, and execute generative and evaluative research and aligning cross border roadmaps with high priority business goals across multiple OS platforms (Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android).
* **Build an Exclusive User Panel:** Go beyond standard recruiting by proactively building and managing a dedicated panel of user personas, ensuring a direct pipeline to our most critical users and cultivating deep customer empathy.
* **Pioneer AI\-Driven Efficiency:** Champion the secure use of AI tools to automate operationalise recurring work such as transcript synthesis, feedback classification, and qualitative coding, freeing up time for deep strategic thinking.
* **Make Research a "Team Sport":** Empower cross functional partners in Product, Design and Engineering to run their own high quality evaluative studies through training frameworks, templates, workflows, etc while mentoring cross function partners to raise the overall research mindset.
* **Exercise Methodological Rigor:** Flexibly apply mixed methodologies including contextual inquiry, usability testing, surveys, and quantitative analysis suited to fast paced product timelines and complex security domains.
* **Drive Global Alignment \& Storytelling:** Collaborate deeply with EPD teams across time zones, synthesizing complex data into compelling stories and actionable recommendations for executive stakeholders.

**What We Are Looking For**
---------------------------


* **Technical Research Expertise:** Demonstrated track record of conducting user research within complex, highly technical B2B, enterprise, security, or developer\-facing domains.
* **Strategic \& Autonomous Thinker:** Ability to translate business goals and technical ambiguity into structured research plans independently while managing competing priorities across multiple product streams.
* **AI Tooling \& Practice:** Curiosity and active experience incorporating AI tools into your research workflow (e.g., automated transcript synthesis, qualitative coding, prompt engineering) to accelerate time\-to\-insight without compromising rigor.
* **Global Collaboration:** Proven success working effectively within globally distributed teams, displaying exceptional written and asynchronous communication skills across overlapping US/APAC working hours.
* **Systems \& Strategic Thinking:** Ability to connect user insights directly to business metrics, product adoption, and technical feasibility.
* **Growth Mindset \& Empathy:** Strong self\-awareness, receptiveness to feedback, and passion for solving high\-stakes identity and security problems.

**Qualifications**
------------------


* **Experience:** 4\+ years of product development experience conducting UX research in enterprise/B2B product environments, OR a Master’s degree/PhD in HCI, Psychology, Anthropology, Sociology, or related field with 2\+ years of experience.
* **Portfolio:** A digital portfolio or case study deck demonstrating end to end research ownership, complex technical problem spaces, generative and evaluative methodologies, and measurable business/product impact.
* **Platform Knowledge:** Experience researching desktop and mobile applications across macOS, Windows, iOS, or Android environments.
* **Security Context:** Background in identity, access management, cybersecurity, or enterprise IT admin tools is a strong plus.

 Sapiens International is looking for a Security Specialist (Cybersecurity Specialist) to join our global IT Security team. This is a hands\-on role focused on administering and improving our core security tools, and on working through security tasks and projects rather than day\-to\-day ticket handling.
   

  

 You will help manage the stability, configuration, and continuous improvement of our key security platforms — with DNS security as a priority area, alongside CSPM, Exposure Management, External Attack Surface Management, Identity Protection, Purview, vulnerability management, and other tools in our security stack.

* Configure, tune, and monitor DNS security policies to block malicious domains and prevent DNS\-based threats
* Review and remediate CSPM misconfigurations and findings across cloud accounts, working with the relevant teams to get them fixed within SLA
* Track and improve the overall CSPM score by closing out misconfigurations and tightening baseline policies
* Monitor Exposure Management and External Attack Surface findings, and drive remediation of internet\-facing risks
* Manage Identity Protection policies and Purview configuration, including reviewing and acting on related alerts
* Configure and maintain proxy/URL filtering and mail relay systems


**Vulnerability Management \& Automation**
* Own the end\-to\-end vulnerability management lifecycle: asset discovery, scan orchestration, CVSS\-based prioritization, ticketing, SLA tracking, and remediation validation
* Build automation that replaces manual reporting, speeds up remediation, and surfaces actionable risk insights for stakeholders
* Develop integrations between security tools and ITSM platforms using Python, REST APIs, and scripting
* Maintain dashboards and automated reporting for vulnerability posture and compliance KPIs


**Projects \& Tasks**
* Work on security tool implementation, upgrades, and improvement projects assigned by the manager
* Partner with other IT and security teams to roll out new controls and policies
* Document standard operating procedures and runbooks for the tools you own


**Requirements**
**Experience**
* 5\+ years of experience in the cybersecurity field, with hands\-on management of security products
* Minimum requirement: hands\-on experience with CrowdStrike Falcon EDR, along with exposure to other CrowdStrike modules such as Identity Protection (IDP) and Exposure Management. Additional experience with CSPM, External Attack Surface Management, Purview, DLP, or Email Protection/Mail Relay is a strong plus
* Experience with vulnerability management programs — ownership of the full lifecycle from discovery through remediation
* Experience building security automation using Python, APIs, or scripting is a plus


**Technical — Must Have**
* Hands\-on experience with the CrowdStrike Falcon platform — EDR and other CrowdStrike modules such as Identity Protection (IDP) and Exposure Management
* Working knowledge of CSPM — identifying misconfigurations, driving remediation, and improving posture score
* Familiarity with External Attack Surface Management tools and findings
* Familiarity with Microsoft Purview
* Practical experience with vulnerability management tools and processes
* Hands\-on experience with DLP — policy design, configuration, and tuning
* Strong knowledge of Windows, Mac, and Linux platforms, including security vulnerability identification and resolution
* Proxy/URL filtering and email relay management
* Security automation: Python, REST APIs, scripting


**Soft Skills \& Language**
* Fluent written and verbal English
* Perceptive, fast learner with a strong sense of urgency
* Able to multi\-task, and remain organized in a fast\-paced global environment
* Highly independent and proactive, with a team\-first mindset


**Advantage (Not Required)**
* Security\-related certifications: CISSP, CISM, CEH, CompTIA Security\+, or vendor\-specific (CrowdStrike, Microsoft, etc.)

description:

1\. Student \& Parent Counselling

* Conduct one\-to\-one counselling sessions with students and parents interested in JEE and NEET programs.
* Understand the student's academic performance, strengths, weaknesses, career aspirations and target examination.
* Identify the student's requirements and recommend the most suitable academic program, batch and learning pathway.
* Explain the importance of systematic JEE/NEET preparation and the role of the institution in achieving the student's goals.
* Build trust and establish strong relationships with students and parents throughout the admission journey.

2\. JEE \& NEET Program Knowledge

* Develop strong knowledge of JEE Main, JEE Advanced, NEET and K\-CET preparation.
* Understand the differences between various programs, batches and preparation pathways.
* Stay updated with changes in entrance examinations, eligibility criteria, examination patterns, important dates and competitive landscape.
* Clearly communicate the academic and career advantages of different programs to students and parents.
* Explain the institution's academic methodology, faculty expertise, results, student achievements and unique differentiators.

3\. Lead Management \& Conversion

* Handle leads generated through digital marketing, website enquiries, phone calls, WhatsApp, walk\-ins, seminars, school outreach, scholarship/entrance tests and other campaigns.
* Respond to new enquiries promptly and professionally.
* Qualify leads based on student profile, academic requirements, course interest and admission readiness.
* Maintain a systematic follow\-up process for all prospective students and parents.
* Convert qualified leads into confirmed admissions.
* Maintain a healthy admission pipeline and ensure that no prospective student is left unattended.

4\. Telephonic Counselling

* Make inbound and outbound calls to prospective students and parents.
* Conduct effective telephonic counselling and generate interest in relevant JEE/NEET programs.
* Explain course benefits, program structure, fee details, scholarships, batch timings and admission procedures.
* Schedule campus visits and face\-to\-face counselling appointments.
* Follow up with prospects at appropriate intervals until the admission decision is made.

5\. Walk\-in \& Face\-to\-Face Counselling

* Handle students and parents visiting the centre.
* Conduct professional and structured counselling sessions.
* Present the institution, academic programs, faculty, results and student success stories effectively.
* Conduct centre/facility tours whenever required.
* Understand parent concerns and provide appropriate solutions.
* Work towards converting walk\-ins into admissions.

* Fees
* Discounts and scholarships
* Competitor institutes
* Faculty
* Results
* Batch size
* Location
* Timings
* Hostel/transport
* Course duration
* Academic methodology
* Parent/student hesitation

* Maintain a strong focus on lead\-to\-admission conversion.
* Track individual performance against admission and revenue targets.
* Take ownership of the complete sales cycle from enquiry to enrolment.
* Consistently work towards improving conversion ratios and revenue contribution.

8\. CRM \& Data Management

* Maintain accurate records of all enquiries, counselling interactions, follow\-ups and admission status in the CRM.
* Update lead status on a daily basis.
* Maintain proper follow\-up schedules and ensure timely callbacks.
* Track hot, warm and cold prospects.

* Ensure parents receive accurate and timely information.
